visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a hand holding a transparent plastic cube box. Inside is an adorable white dog-shaped cake made of textured cream to look like fur. It has two small dark chocolate eyes, a chocolate nose, and a tiny pink floral decoration on its forehead. The background shows a bright, refrigerated display case in a commercial setting. (2) The scene shifts to reveal several rows of identical dog cakes in transparent boxes inside a bright refrigerator. Each cake has a slightly different colored hat or accessory. The lighting is very bright and clean, typical of a modern bakery or department store food court. (3) A wider shot reveals a wooden pop-up counter in a sleek, modern shopping mall. The counter has the brand name "ONCE DESSERT" in dark letters. A woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a beige professional blazer, stands behind the counter assisting customers. Nearby is a Coach luxury store entrance. (4) The woman in the beige blazer is shown carefully packing a boxed cake into a silver reflective thermal insulation bag. She adds small blue cold packs to ensure the dessert stays fresh. The counter is cluttered with various promotional items and boxes of colorful floral cookies. (5) A close-up shot shows a white plastic fork slicing through the side of the fluffy white dog cake. The texture appears very soft and airy. The interior of the cake reveals pale yellow sponge layers separated by light cream, emphasizing a delicate and artisanal quality. (6) A hand holds up a square box of "Garden Cookies," which contains an assortment of flower, leaf, and clover-shaped biscuits in colors like green, pink, and yellow. A single green four-leaf clover cookie is picked up and shown to the camera to highlight its detail. (7) The video concludes with the woman waving cheerfully from behind the counter. A large pink-tinted text box appears on screen, providing detailed information about the pop-up shop's duration, location at Hanshin Arena 2F, and specific dates.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice narrating in Mandarin begins immediately. The speaker's tone is extremely friendly and energetic. Accompanying the voice is an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic guitar BGM with a bright, major-key melody that sets a cheerful and welcoming atmosphere. (2) As the narrator mentions the purchase location, the sound of a plastic thermal bag being crinkled and items being placed inside creates a series of sharp, high-frequency incidental rustling noises. These sounds are well-mixed with the constant, rhythmic strumming of the acoustic guitar background music. (3) The narration continues with a descriptive and slightly softer tone as the speaker explains the cake's creamy texture. The audio focus is on the clarity of the speech, which has a moderate rate and high emotional arousal. There are no competing background voices or loud mall ambient noises. (4) A soft percussive clinking sound is audible as the fork touches the plate and slices through the cake sponge. The music continues to drive the rhythm of the video, maintaining a consistent tempo and a positive emotional valence without any sudden shifts in volume. (5) The speaker's voice becomes more urgent and inviting as she gives a call to action. The BGM maintains its bright acoustic texture until the very end, where the speaker gives a final cheerful sign-off, followed by a quick fade in both voice and music.
